STUFFED DAL JAGGERY PARATHA
By: okilakarthikeyan
Published: Saturday, October 15, 2011 - 7:44am

Ingredients




DAL-100G
JAGGERY-11/2 CUP
COCOUT FLAKES-1CUP
CARDAMOM POWDER-1TSP
DAL-100G
JAGGERY-11/2 CUP
COCOUT FLAKES-1CUP
CARDAMOM POWDER-1TSP
DAL-100G
JAGGERY-11/2 CUP
COCOUT FLAKES-1CUP
CARDAMOM POWDER-1TSP
WATER
SALT
SUGAR-1TSP
TURMERIC POWDER-1/2TSP
BANANA
GHEE

Preparation

1 BOILING: 2 Switch on the flame and take the pan add water, dal and turmeric powder also. 3 Dal cooked only half boiling.Don't mash tha dal. 4 After boiling the dal filter the water and separete the dal in 5 mins 5 ADDING: 6 After boiling dal add  jaggery,cocout flakes and cardamom powder (or) cardamom mixing well 7 BLENDER: 8 Take a mixer bowl add the dal, jaggery,cocoutflakes and cardamom powder.. 9 Blend in 2 times only.don't blend in many times. 10 FLOUR: 11 Take a separete bowl add flour,salt and sugar. 12 After mixing the flour add some amount of water.do not use too much water. 13 Mixing the flour  and gets in round shape.wait for 10 mins. 14 After take the dough each balls in round shape 15 take a chappati kal roll the dough in flat shape add the blender mixing 1tablespoon in each balls.cover the mixture in 4sides. 16 Switch on the flame take the dosa pan ,drop the dough and add some amount of oil. 17 Turn in both sides still comes in golden brown. 18 SERVING: 19 Serving the stuffed dal jaggery paratha with banana and ghee.

About

KOKILA KARTHIKEYAN
